scores.note: 2 'involve in many others', 5 'enlist in many others', 10 'entangle in many others' are ungrammatical with the fixed 'in'. 4 'lure in' means entice, wrong meaning. 7 'hook in' is casual and odd. 8 'catch in' and 9 'enfold in' do not mean drawing countries into a war. 6 'sweep in' is usable.
